text:
Asha - People Ops: Quick drop 1: tiny calibration + upward-feedback micro-scripts for mid-cycle reviews. Short, scan-friendly, usable asynchronously.

Liam - Eng Manager: Love it. Can we add an anchor line for expected level behaviors (IC vs senior)?

Asha - People Ops: Yes 1 added two 1-line behavioral anchors and a peer feedback one-liner.

Carmen - Product: Please include an example that calls out measurable impact for cross-functional work.

Asha - People Ops: Done 1 see "outcome phrasing" examples below. Keep everything <3 lines.

Noah - SWE: These will make calibration notes so much faster. Thanks.

hr-bot: Heads-up 1 calibration sync scheduled: https://company.calendar/calibration (reminder in 3 days).

--- paste-ready micro-scripts ---

```
IC upward-feedback (one line):
You unblock me when you proactively share design tradeoffs; recent PR #842 sped review by 2 days.

Peer feedback (one-liner):
Great collaborator: consistently surfaces edge-cases in design reviews; helped avoid regressions.

Manager observation (2 lines):
1) Outcome: shipped X integration; adoption 9% of connected teams in 2 weeks.
2) Development note: needs practice delegating test ownership.

Behavioral anchor - IC (1 line):
Owns well-scoped features end-to-end; asks for help for cross-team dependencies early.

Behavioral anchor - Senior IC (1 line):
Shapes roadmap-level tradeoffs and mentors peers on design decisions; drives cross-team alignment.

Calibration note - risk flag (1 line):
Delivery risk: external API contract not finalized; suggest gating feature behind feature-flag.

Outcome phrasing examples (one-liners):
- Feature: "Launched in-app onboarding; 14% lift in activation (A->B) for new users."
- Cross-functional: "Led infra+product sprint to stabilize sync; reduced drop rate by 18%."
- Platform: "Cut p95 latency 320ms -> 250ms; projected $6k/month savings."
```

--- quick how-to for managers (one para) ---
Asha - People Ops: Use the one-liners to seed calibration notes and keep nuance in 1:1s. Ask direct questions ("where did you need help?"), insist on artifacts (link PR/issue), and call out expected behaviors versus outcomes. Keep comments factual and recent.

Liam - Eng Manager: Can we have an async variant that prompts ICs to self-rate confidence on a 1-5 scale?

Asha - People Ops: Added a short self-rate line below.

--- async self-rate snippet ---

```
Self-rate (1 line):
Confidence (1-5): 4 - delivered scope, minor follow-ups expected; linked PR #843.
```

Carmen - Product: Adding this to product-eng handbook now. Nice and short.

Noah - SWE: FYI I used the peer feedback template and pasted into a docs comment, got an appreciative DM.

hr-bot: Logged: people-ops/templates/calibration-upward-micro (v1).

Asha - People Ops: Thanks team 1 ping me if you want templates tailored by level or for ICmanager calibration decks.
